You are an expert in OpenSCAD and in designing 3D-printable (FDM) parts for biology laboratories.
Write one complete, self-contained OpenSCAD file that builds exactly the part the user describes.

Rules:
1. Units are millimetres. Use the user's dimensions exactly - they were measured with calipers.
2. Put every dimension in a named variable at the top of the file, with a short comment.
3. Model the part in the print orientation the user gives: it rests on the XY plane at z = 0 and builds upward (+Z). Unless told otherwise, centre it on the origin in X and Y.
4. Use only built-in OpenSCAD: cube, cylinder, sphere, polygon, circle, square, linear_extrude, rotate_extrude, translate, rotate, mirror, union, difference, intersection, hull, for. Do not use include, use or any external library.
5. In difference(), make every cutting shape extend 0.01-1 mm past the faces it cuts, so no faces are exactly coplanar.
6. Set $fn = 64 (or more) on curved shapes so holes come out round and to size.
7. Build repeated features (hole grids, slots, teeth, grooves) with for loops.
8. The file must render to a valid solid with no errors.

Reply with only the code, in a single ```openscad code block.

Design a T-shaped nut that slides in the slot of an aluminium extrusion. Seen along its length (the X axis) its cross-section is an upside-down T: a bottom flange 14 mm wide (Y) and 2 mm thick, from z = 0 to z = 2, and above it a centred neck 7 mm wide rising to z = 6. The profile is 20 mm long along X, centred on the origin in X and Y. A 4.5 mm hole for a screw runs vertically through the centre of the part.

Design a flat tensile test specimen (a dog bone) for testing printed plastic. It is 3 mm thick, lies on the bed and is symmetric about the origin, 110 mm long in total along X. Seen from above: a narrow gauge section 8 mm wide (Y) and 30 mm long in the middle, a 15 mm wide grip section 30 mm long at each end, and between each grip and the gauge a 10 mm long transition whose width changes linearly from 15 to 8 mm.

ref:
// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone), print flat on the bed
// Units: mm. Symmetric about origin in X and Y, base at z = 0.

thickness      = 3;    // specimen thickness (Z)
total_length   = 110;  // overall length (X)
gauge_width    = 8;    // gauge section width (Y)
gauge_length   = 30;   // gauge section length (X)
grip_width     = 15;   // grip section width (Y)
grip_length    = 30;   // grip section length at each end (X)
trans_length   = 10;   // transition length (linear taper) at each side (X)

// Derived X stations (positive side)
x_gauge_end = gauge_length / 2;                 // 15
x_trans_end = x_gauge_end + trans_length;       // 25
x_grip_end  = x_trans_end + grip_length;        // 55 = total_length/2

hg = gauge_width / 2;  // gauge half-width
hw = grip_width / 2;   // grip half-width

// Sanity check of overall length
assert(abs(2 * x_grip_end - total_length) < 1e-6,
       "Section lengths do not add up to total_length");

linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = [
        [-x_grip_end,  -hw],
        [-x_trans_end, -hw],
        [-x_gauge_end, -hg],
        [ x_gauge_end, -hg],
        [ x_trans_end, -hw],
        [ x_grip_end,  -hw],
        [ x_grip_end,   hw],
        [ x_trans_end,  hw],
        [ x_gauge_end,  hg],
        [-x_gauge_end,  hg],
        [-x_trans_end,  hw],
        [-x_grip_end,   hw]
    ]);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone) for printed plastics
// Print orientation: lying flat on the bed, symmetric about the origin in X and Y

// ---------------- Dimensions (mm) ----------------
thickness      = 4;    // specimen thickness (Z)
total_length   = 140;  // overall length (X)
gauge_width    = 8;    // width of narrow gauge section (Y)
gauge_length   = 50;   // length of gauge section (X)
grip_width     = 19;   // width of grip sections (Y)
grip_length    = 35;   // length of each grip section (X)
trans_length   = 10;   // length of each linear transition (X)

// ---------------- Derived values ----------------
x_gauge = gauge_length / 2;                 // gauge ends at +/- 25
x_trans = x_gauge + trans_length;           // transition ends at +/- 35
x_end   = x_trans + grip_length;            // grip ends at +/- 70
hg      = gauge_width / 2;                  // half gauge width
hw      = grip_width / 2;                   // half grip width

// Sanity check: sections add up to total length
assert(abs(2 * x_end - total_length) < 1e-6,
       "Section lengths do not sum to total_length");

// ---------------- Model ----------------
linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = [
        [-x_end,   -hw],
        [-x_trans, -hw],
        [-x_gauge, -hg],
        [ x_gauge, -hg],
        [ x_trans, -hw],
        [ x_end,   -hw],
        [ x_end,    hw],
        [ x_trans,  hw],
        [ x_gauge,  hg],
        [-x_gauge,  hg],
        [-x_trans,  hw],
        [-x_end,    hw]
    ]);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone) - prints flat on the bed
// All dimensions in millimetres

thickness      = 3;    // specimen thickness (Z)
total_length   = 130;  // overall length along X
gauge_width    = 6;    // gauge section width (Y)
gauge_length   = 50;   // gauge section length (X)
grip_width     = 15;   // grip section width (Y)
grip_length    = 30;   // grip section length at each end (X)
trans_length   = 10;   // linear transition length between grip and gauge (X)

// Derived X positions (half-lengths from origin)
x_gauge = gauge_length / 2;              // 25
x_trans = x_gauge + trans_length;        // 35
x_end   = x_trans + grip_length;         // 65 (= total_length/2)

// Sanity check
assert(abs(2 * x_end - total_length) < 0.001,
       "Section lengths do not sum to total_length");

// Outline (counter-clockwise), symmetric about X and Y axes
outline = [
    [-x_end,   -grip_width / 2],
    [-x_trans, -grip_width / 2],
    [-x_gauge, -gauge_width / 2],
    [ x_gauge, -gauge_width / 2],
    [ x_trans, -grip_width / 2],
    [ x_end,   -grip_width / 2],
    [ x_end,    grip_width / 2],
    [ x_trans,  grip_width / 2],
    [ x_gauge,  gauge_width / 2],
    [-x_gauge,  gauge_width / 2],
    [-x_trans,  grip_width / 2],
    [-x_end,    grip_width / 2]
];

linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(outline);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone)
// Lies flat on the bed, symmetric about the origin in X and Y.

// ---------------- Parameters ----------------
thickness      = 3;    // specimen thickness (Z)
gauge_width    = 8;    // width of narrow gauge section (Y)
gauge_length   = 40;   // length of gauge section (X)
grip_width     = 20;   // width of grip sections (Y)
grip_length    = 35;   // length of each grip section (X)
trans_length   = 10;   // length of each linear transition (X)

total_length   = gauge_length + 2*trans_length + 2*grip_length; // = 130 mm

// Derived X stations (from centre outward)
x_gauge_end = gauge_length/2;                  // 20
x_trans_end = x_gauge_end + trans_length;      // 30
x_grip_end  = x_trans_end + grip_length;       // 65

gw2 = gauge_width/2;   // half gauge width
pw2 = grip_width/2;    // half grip width

// ---------------- Outline ----------------
// Counter-clockwise outline of the dog bone seen from above
outline = [
    [ x_grip_end, -pw2],
    [ x_grip_end,  pw2],
    [ x_trans_end, pw2],
    [ x_gauge_end, gw2],
    [-x_gauge_end, gw2],
    [-x_trans_end, pw2],
    [-x_grip_end,  pw2],
    [-x_grip_end, -pw2],
    [-x_trans_end,-pw2],
    [-x_gauge_end,-gw2],
    [ x_gauge_end,-gw2],
    [ x_trans_end,-pw2]
];

// ---------------- Model ----------------
linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = outline);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone) - prints flat on the bed
// All dimensions in mm

thickness      = 3;    // specimen thickness (Z)
gauge_width    = 6;    // gauge section width (Y)
gauge_length   = 30;   // gauge section length (X)
grip_width     = 20;   // grip section width (Y)
grip_length    = 25;   // grip section length (X), each end
trans_length   = 15;   // linear transition length (X), each side

total_length = gauge_length + 2*trans_length + 2*grip_length; // = 110

// Key X positions (half-lengths from origin)
x_gauge = gauge_length/2;                  // 15
x_trans = x_gauge + trans_length;          // 30
x_end   = x_trans + grip_length;           // 55

gw2 = gauge_width/2;  // 3
rw2 = grip_width/2;   // 10

// Outline traced counter-clockwise, symmetric about origin
outline = [
    [-x_end,  -rw2],
    [-x_trans,-rw2],
    [-x_gauge,-gw2],
    [ x_gauge,-gw2],
    [ x_trans,-rw2],
    [ x_end,  -rw2],
    [ x_end,   rw2],
    [ x_trans, rw2],
    [ x_gauge, gw2],
    [-x_gauge, gw2],
    [-x_trans, rw2],
    [-x_end,   rw2]
];

linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = outline);

// Ring weight for flask neck in a water bath
// Torus lying flat on the bed, centred on origin in X/Y

tube_d      = 16;   // cross-section circle diameter (mm)
ring_r      = 22;   // radius of the circle swept by the tube centre (mm)
tube_r      = tube_d / 2;          // cross-section radius (mm)
outer_d     = 2 * (ring_r + tube_r); // overall diameter = 60 mm
mid_z       = tube_r;              // middle plane height = 8 mm

$fn = 128;          // smoothness of curves

translate([0, 0, mid_z])
    rotate_extrude($fn = 128)
        translate([ring_r, 0, 0])
            circle(r = tube_r, $fn = 64);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone), printed flat on the bed
// Units: mm

// ---------------- Parameters ----------------
total_length   = 150;  // overall length along X
thickness      = 4;    // specimen thickness (Z)
gauge_width    = 8;    // width of narrow gauge section (Y)
gauge_length   = 50;   // length of gauge section (X)
grip_width     = 20;   // width of grip sections (Y)
grip_length    = 35;   // length of each grip section (X)
trans_length   = 15;   // length of each linear transition (X)

// Derived X positions (from centre)
x_gauge = gauge_length / 2;                 // 25
x_trans = x_gauge + trans_length;           // 40
x_end   = x_trans + grip_length;            // 75 (= total_length/2)

gw2 = gauge_width / 2;  // half gauge width
pw2 = grip_width / 2;   // half grip width

// Sanity check
assert(abs(2 * x_end - total_length) < 1e-6,
       "Section lengths do not sum to total_length");

// ---------------- Outline (top view) ----------------
outline = [
    [-x_end,    -pw2],
    [-x_trans,  -pw2],
    [-x_gauge,  -gw2],
    [ x_gauge,  -gw2],
    [ x_trans,  -pw2],
    [ x_end,    -pw2],
    [ x_end,     pw2],
    [ x_trans,   pw2],
    [ x_gauge,   gw2],
    [-x_gauge,   gw2],
    [-x_trans,   pw2],
    [-x_end,     pw2]
];

// ---------------- Model ----------------
linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = outline);

// Ring weight for flask neck in a water bath
// Torus lying flat on the bed, built upward from z = 0

tube_d       = 16;               // cross-section circle diameter (mm)
ring_r       = 30;               // radius of the circle swept by the cross-section centre (mm)
tube_r       = tube_d / 2;       // cross-section radius (mm)
outer_d      = 2 * (ring_r + tube_r); // overall diameter = 76 mm (reference)
mid_z        = tube_r;           // middle plane height = 8 mm

$fn = 128;                       // smoothness of curves

translate([0, 0, mid_z])
    rotate_extrude($fn = 128)
        translate([ring_r, 0, 0])
            circle(r = tube_r, $fn = 64);

// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone), printed flat on the bed
// All dimensions in mm

thickness      = 3;    // specimen thickness (Z)
total_length   = 130;  // overall length (X)
gauge_width    = 8;    // width of narrow gauge section (Y)
gauge_length   = 50;   // length of gauge section (X)
grip_width     = 20;   // width of grip sections (Y)
grip_length    = 30;   // length of each grip section (X)
trans_length   = 10;   // length of each linear transition (X)

// Derived X stations (from centre outward)
x_gauge = gauge_length / 2;            // 25: end of gauge
x_trans = x_gauge + trans_length;      // 35: end of transition
x_end   = x_trans + grip_length;       // 65: end of grip (= total_length/2)

gw = gauge_width / 2;   // gauge half-width
pw = grip_width  / 2;   // grip half-width

// Sanity check: total length must match sum of sections
assert(abs(2 * x_end - total_length) < 1e-6,
       "Section lengths do not sum to total_length");

// Outline seen from above, symmetric about origin
linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = [

        [ x_end,   -pw],

// Ring weight for flask neck in water bath
// Torus lying flat on the bed, centred on origin in X/Y

tube_d     = 8;    // cross-section circle diameter (mm)
ring_r     = 28;   // radius of the cross-section centre circle (mm)

mid_z      = tube_d / 2;           // middle plane height = 4 mm
